races.name: Market Square Monasterevin Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
BENOWN made a promising start to his career when runner-up here last month, beaten only by a more streetwise rival, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Controlla is feared most dropped into a maiden for the first time, while Heralds March is one to note with his debut run behind him.

  1. BENOWN (IRE)
  2. CONTROLLA (IRE)
  3. HERALDS MARCH (IRE)

races.name: Kwiff More Bang For Your Bet Rated Race
races.verdict:
A case can be made for most of these but INVINCIBLE WILL rates the pick at these weights and is fancied to bag a second C&D success at the chief expense of recent Leopardstown third Killashee Warrior. Lewis Carroll remains unexposed and can't be discounted after an absence, while Oro Blanco also needs factoring into this competitive event.

  1. INVINCIBLE WILL (IRE)
  2. KILLASHEE WARRIOR
  3. LEWIS CARROLL (IRE)

races.name: Kwiff Supercharged Joe McGrath Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
KEKE won this corresponding event in 2024 and he gets the vote with Colin Keane taking over. Stable-switcher Bounty completes a strong hand for the Edward Lynam yard, with Namiid and Stag Night other likely players in a wide-open renewal.

  1. KEKE
  2. BOUNTY (IRE)
  3. NAMIID (IRE)

races.name: Churchill Tyres Beresford Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
NOBLE EXHIBIT looks a smart prospect and is fancied to provide his all-powerful stable with another success in this event. City of Dubai and Venetian Power may give him most to think about.

  1. NOBLE EXHIBIT (IRE)
  2. CITY OF DUBAI (IRE)
  3. VENETIAN POWER (IRE)

races.name: Izuzu Ireland Handicap
races.verdict:
HEADMASTER wasn’t seen to best effect last time, but the return to 7f, a further 2 lb drop and a useful claimer taking over all suggest a bold bid is on the cards. Dmaniac won twice here on heavy ground in March and rates the main danger, with a quick return to his favoured venue likely to suit. Love Billy Boy returns to handicaps in a first-time visor from below his last winning mark and is respected.

  1. HEADMASTER
  2. DMANIAC
  3. LOVE BILLY BOY (IRE)

races.name: Goffs Million
races.verdict:
A range of abilities on show with TREAN given the tentative vote down in class having shaped as though still in top form in the Group 1 National Stakes over C&D 2 weeks ago. Carry The Flag is a huge threat on form but with 7f not certain to suit, Green Dreamer could be the chief threat.

  1. TREAN (IRE)
  2. GREEN DREAMER (IRE)
  3. CARRY THE FLAG (IRE)

races.name: Gra Chocolates Maiden
races.verdict:
COME WHAT MAY stands out on paper being a brother to the high-class winner up to 1½m Desert Crown and gets the nod to make a belated winning debut before market clues. Kenough showed promise first time up at this venue back in the spring and is a likely improver upped in trip, while Leopold The First is an obvious contender back in maiden company providing he casts aside a lesser effort last time.

  1. COME WHAT MAY (IRE)
  2. KENOUGH (FR)
  3. LEOPOLD THE FIRST (IRE)

races.name: Equiwinner Patches Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
TOGETHER NOW showed plenty when runner-up in a 7f maiden here a year ago (Oaks winner Thundering On back in fourth) and this half-sister to City of Troy can start making up for lost time with fitness unlikely to be an issue. Goddess of War is worth another chance to confirm debut promise so is second choice, while Emberelle isn't taken lightly after her eye-catching debut at Navan.

  1. TOGETHER NOW (USA)
  2. GODDESS OF WAR (SAF)
  3. EMBERELLE (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF 'Jersey Lily' Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
A few potential improvers line up but at the foot of the weights, FIRE THUNDER makes lots of appeal having looked well suited by 7f last month, form boosted by the third since. Al Samsama, Sierra Belle and Polyxena all have something to recommend them.

  1. FIRE THUNDER (IRE)
  2. AL SAMSAMA (IRE)
  3. SIERRA BELLE

races.name: Tattersalls Online Royal Lodge Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
Perhaps best to narrow this down to unbeaten pair FIRST LAW and Burning Up. The former was snugly on top of Rocket Boy in a Haydock listed race 3 weeks ago and is narrowly preferred. The selection's stablemate Quest For Stars may prove best of the remainder.

  1. FIRST LAW (IRE)
  2. BURNING UP
  3. QUEST FOR STARS (FR)

races.name: Tattersalls Sceptre Sessions Cheveley Park Stakes (Fillies' Group 1)
races.verdict:
A much-anticipated renewal, with preference for SUN GODDESS who again made an excellent impression when powering clear for victory in the Moyglare at the Curragh, taking her record to 5 from 7. She can provide her leading yard with a third consecutive win in this Group 1, though Senorita Bonita and Libertango have also looked exciting fillies and are much respected.

  1. SUN GODDESS (IRE)
  2. SENORITA BONITA (IRE)
  3. LIBERTANGO (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls Middle Park Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
The highly-promising INNER CITY BLUES can provide Charlie Appleby with a third successive win in this Group 1, with his July Stakes form looking well up to standard despite the small field. Orthodox is the obvious threat if reproducing his Royal Ascot form, while the unbeaten Push The Boat Out looks the pick of the Irish.

  1. INNER CITY BLUES (IRE)
  2. ORTHODOX
  3. PUSH THE BOAT OUT (IRE)

races.name: bet365 Cambridgeshire (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
The Gosden stable's prowess in this race is well known, particularly with 3-y-os, and GAVRIEL looks just the type to enhance that record. His defeat of Balzac at Ascot earlier in the month was strongly boosted when that one landed a good prize at Newbury last Saturday and this Frankel colt can make light of a 4-lb penalty. Erzindjan, Wild Thoughts and Harmonics, another low-mileage 3-y-o from the Gosden stable, head the many dangers.

  1. GAVRIEL
  2. ERZINDJAN (IRE)
  3. WILD THOUGHTS (IRE)

races.name: Blandford Bloodstock 25th Anniversary EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market should prove highly revealing but the vote goes to RUBY SANDS who shaped well on her debut when third at Newbury and can build on it to get off the mark with Tom Marquand aboard. Roger Varian continues among the winners and his newcomers Miss Jane Hadley (second choice) and Out Late both make plenty of appeal. Queen Of The Gulf and Aquila D'Oro are other debutantes who also command respect in this intriguing juvenile maiden.

  1. RUBY SANDS
  2. MISS JANE HADLEY (IRE)
  3. OUT LATE (IRE)

races.name: Hunt Family Fund Handicap
races.verdict:
THE FINGAL RAVEN has been running consistently well and the return of blinkers/Saffie Osborne could both be catalysts for a second success of the year. Superposition is 1-1 here and feared most if on a going day, with hat-trick-seeking Huscal respected up in grade.

  1. THE FINGAL RAVEN (IRE)
  2. SUPERPOSITION
  3. HUSCAL (IRE)

races.name: Theakston Brewing Legends Since 1827 EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Having shaped encouragingly on his first 2 outings, BULLETSNAP wasn't able to find any progress at Windsor last time but he's well worth another chance for his leading yard. He gets the vote ahead of Scenic Route, who has offered plenty to work on in his 2 starts, while Time To Play could step forward from his debut run.

  1. BULLETSNAP (IRE)
  2. SCENIC ROUTE (IRE)
  3. TIME TO PLAY (IRE)

races.name: Lloyd Landrover Ripon Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ZARAKOVA is a lightly-raced filly on the up and rates the one to beat, having improved again despite meeting trouble on nursery debut last time. Forest Berry has won twice recently and remains on an upward curve, so rates the chief threat, while Aphra Behn is also respected.

  1. ZARAKOVA
  2. FOREST BERRY
  3. APHRA BEHN

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Handicap
races.verdict:
ACCRUAL made the perfect start for this yard last month when winning a race that has worked out well and, though not so good in 3 starts since, he's still very well treated on old form and is taken to resume winning ways up against Tiva and Rock of England who both come here in excellent form.

  1. ACCRUAL
  2. TIVA (IRE)
  3. ROCK OF ENGLAND (IRE)

races.name: Ripon Cathedral City Of The Dales Handicap
races.verdict:
EYE OF DUBAI bounced back to form in no uncertain terms last week and looks well treated as he attempts to win this race for an incredible third time in a row. He may ideally want softer ground, but he scored on good going in this race last year and looks sure to go well. His biggest danger may be his in-form stablemate Dark Thirty, while Another Baar is lurking from falling mark and could go well at bigger odds.

  1. EYE OF DUBAI
  2. DARK THIRTY (IRE)
  3. ANOTHER BAAR

races.name: Michael Raby Memorial Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SHOWTIME MAHOMES took a step in the right direction when third last time and races from the same career-low mark here so he's taken to resume winning ways. Big Apple Jack finally broke his duck last time and should go well from just a 3 lb higher mark, while Good Karma is so consistent that he's hard to see being out of the frame.

  1. SHOWTIME MAHOMES
  2. BIG APPLE JACK
  3. GOOD KARMA

races.name: Michael Raby Memorial Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HURSTWOOD won twice at Redcar before completing a hat-trick over C&D in September 2022 and is taken to repeat the feat 4 years on. Kings Merchant has his 2 lb rise for his recent Catterick success more than offset by the promising Conor Whiteley's claim and is second choice ahead of Valentine Catcher and Angel Summer.

  1. HURSTWOOD
  2. KINGS MERCHANT
  3. VALENTINE CATCHER

races.name: Jozef White Last Day Of Freedom Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WADACRE ICON shaped promisingly behind a useful prospect on his recent Carlisle debut and is narrowly preferred to Koala Rose, whose leading yard is bidding for a third win in this since 2019, and Sir Mark Prescott's Walking On Stars.

  1. WADACRE ICON
  2. KOALA ROSE (IRE)
  3. WALKING ON STARS (IRE)

races.name: Thank You To Our Groundstaff Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ZIMMERMAN has had a fruitful time of things recently and while his winning run ended at Chester last week, he was by no means discredited and remains of interest from a handy mark still on old form. Tarbat Ness is second choice.

  1. ZIMMERMAN
  2. TARBAT NESS
  3. SAX APPEAL

races.name: Market Rasen Racecourse Conference & Events Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Southwell bumper winner NO MORE TEARDROPS may prolong Elated's wait for a breakthrough success. Harry Derham's newcomer Poets Pearl looks a likely danger, especially if supported.

  1. NO MORE TEARDROPS
  2. ELATED
  3. POETS PEARL (IRE)

races.name: Market Rasen Racecourse Caravan Site Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOMENT OF LIGHT could be a very useful early-season juvenile and can make it 2-2, perhaps at the expense of Fairyhouse Flat winner Pass The Buck, who's stable has done well with similar types from Ireland.

  1. MOMENT OF LIGHT
  2. PASS THE BUCK (IRE)
  3. VIETNORM (IRE)

races.name: Summer Plate Ladies Day 2027 On Sale Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SURE TOUCH looks set to enhance his fine course record, though may have to dig deep to peg back Fringill Dike, in what promises to be an interesting tactical affair.

  1. SURE TOUCH
  2. FRINGILL DIKE (IRE)
  3. NICKELFORCE (IRE)

races.name: Dine In Altior's Restaurant Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GALWAY REEL was no match for Huckleberry Sting over C&D in July but now meets that rival on 12 lb better terms now setting out for Olly Murphy, so it's reasonable to believe he can reverse the form and land this race for a second year running. Veteran Ribeye also has a more favourable weight pull with Huckleberry Sting and is second choice.

  1. GALWAY REEL (IRE)
  2. RIBEYE
  3. HUCKLEBERRY STING

races.name: 10 Pound County Racedays Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TIMELY SALUTE has made an excellent start switched to hurdles for his new yard and looks the way to go off an attractive mark for his handicap debut. Olly Murphy's new recruit Woodstock City is not without interest though on his first go in handicaps, especially if the market vibes are positive. Yanka Blue and Finjimk appeal as the pick of the rest for place purposes.

  1. TIMELY SALUTE
  2. WOODSTOCK CITY
  3. YANKA BLUE (IRE)

races.name: Block Free Services Lincoln Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The Twiston-Davies team usually has their string ready to roll at this time of year (well-backed winner at Perth on Thursday) and UN SENS A LA VIE is fancied to make it 3-3 at this course. He's narrowly preferred to Indian River, who returns on the back of a progressive juvenile season, with Indemnity the pick of the older horses following his storming run in the Summer Hurdle here.

  1. UN SENS A LA VIE (FR)
  2. INDIAN RIVER (IRE)
  3. INDEMNITY (IRE)

races.name: Agriculture Raceday Returns On 12th November Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The fences got in the way for the THE CLONMEL KID here last time so he's an interesting one for a return to hurdling off what could be a winnable mark. Ramaah is weighted to turn the tables on Matoury on their C&D form in July and that pair may provide the main opposition.

  1. THE CLONMEL KID (IRE)
  2. RAMAAH
  3. MATOURY

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
Golden Mile runner-up CERULEAN BAY often goes well at this track and is taken to resume winning ways with his sights slightly lowered. Centigrade and Eternal Force are feared for the excellent Beckett and Haggas yards respectively, with both 4-y-os looking well treated on their best form.

  1. CERULEAN BAY (IRE)
  2. CENTIGRADE (IRE)
  3. ETERNAL FORCE

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
ANCIENT STATE continues to progress and is fancied to bag a fifth victory of the season at the chief expense of multiple course scorer Trilby who acquitted himself really well in last week's Ayr Silver Cup and rates a big threat back here. Fandom is another who merits plenty of respect off a handy-looking mark, while last year's victor King of Light and in-form duo Hucklesbrook and Elara May also need considering in this highly competitive sprint.

  1. ANCIENT STATE (IRE)
  2. TRILBY
  3. FANDOM

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Roger Varian continues among the winners and his KAGUYAHIME is fancied to add to the tally on the back of a promising initial third at Ascot, form which gives her the clear edge here. Karl Burke's She's Got A Way rates the chief threat if, as expected, taking a sizeable step forward from her debut Doncaster third over this longer trip. My Girl Dee Mo and Woollahra can fight it out for minor honours.

  1. KAGUYAHIME (IRE)
  2. SHE'S GOT A WAY (IRE)
  3. MY GIRL DEE MO (IRE)

races.name: Forever Our Mike Handicap
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances in a good quality sprint handicap but 3-y-o ANGEL GABRIEL marked himself out as one to keep on side this autumn when making all at Windsor 4 weeks ago and a 4 lb rise in the weights doesn't look prohibitive with forecast conditions firmly in his favour. Art Lover has shaped well on all 4 starts this season and is a threat, along with Ayr Bronze Cup second Rousing Encore. Storm Force and Golden Long, if handling conditions are others to factor in.

  1. ANGEL GABRIEL (IRE)
  2. ART LOVER (IRE)
  3. ROUSING ENCORE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Nursery
races.verdict:
CAMARDA RC failed to justify strong support when runner-up over 1m at Windsor last time but had looked a good prospect when scoring at Epsom prior to that and is taken to bounce back in style reverted to 7f here. Fellow nursery debutant Mister Whippy also looks capable of better and rates a big threat, while Mind Those Steps and Wolf Bay can also have a say in an interesting nursery,

  1. CAMARDA RC
  2. MISTER WHIPPY (USA)
  3. MIND THOSE STEPS

races.name: J&P Civil Engineering British EBF Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
A few of these bring potential but the vote goes to IMPASTO who shaped very well when a debut runner-up in a strong Ascot maiden (form working out well) and can go one better now. Both Hands To Yourself and Royal Acclamation also look to have better days ahead of them and can also have a say.

  1. IMPASTO
  2. HANDS TO YOURSELF (IRE)
  3. ROYAL ACCLAMATION

races.name: William Hill Daily Winnings Boost Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MICK COLLINS did some eye-catching late work over 1½m last time, and the step up in distance may see him open his account for current connections. If there's a fly in the ointment, it could be Sharp Move, who looks interesting now tried over a significantly longer trip. Course winner Gentle Warrior also appeals off a much-reduced mark, along with unexposed stayer Alther Walden.

  1. MICK COLLINS (IRE)
  2. SHARP MOVE (IRE)
  3. GENTLE WARRIOR (IRE)

races.name: Gent's Night Sat 24th October Handicap
races.verdict:
LET'S GO HUGO has been rejuvenated since being refitted with cheekpieces and can notch a fourth win in just over a month. Mimime arrives in good form and can pose the biggest threat ahead of Protest Rally.

  1. LET'S GO HUGO (IRE)
  2. MIMIME (IRE)
  3. PROTEST RALLY (IRE)

races.name: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROMOTOSO showed form akin to that of her debut when finding only one too good in a Windsor novice 3 weeks ago and a repeat may well be enough to see William Knight's filly get off the mark. Inglewood and Shaniko are 2 live threats, though, with Mollisha also needing to be factored in having had a plausible excuse at Chester last time.

  1. ROMOTOSO
  2. INGLEWOOD
  3. SHANIKO

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ELYAM made light work of a 2-year absence to score in facile fashion on debut for this yard and he can make a successful transition into handicap company. Spring Is Sprung has shaped well in defeat several times since his C&D win and is also shortlisted, whilst Paddy's Day should be more of a force returned to all-weather.

  1. ELYAM
  2. SPRING IS SPRUNG (FR)
  3. PADDY'S DAY (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HYPNOTISED shaped well from some way back at Doncaster 2 weeks ago and Harry Charlton's 3-y-o gets the nod here ahead of Moulin Booj. Kylian remains on a very eye-catching mark and could also have a say if things pan out more favourably for him this time.

  1. HYPNOTISED
  2. MOULIN BOOJ (IRE)
  3. KYLIAN (IRE)

races.name: Tipsy Tapas At Winter Ladies Evening Handicap
races.verdict:
MADJID has run well from the front of late, scoring twice from last 3 starts, and he's liable to get his way out in the lead here so could prove very hard to pass over a trip he's unexposed at. Patrol is knocking on the door and should go well returned to a track he's had success at, while Bondi needs keeping an eye on in the betting.

  1. MADJID
  2. PATROL (IRE)
  3. BONDI (IRE)

races.name: 3rd And 10th Oktoberfest Race Nights Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
PYRAMID'S debut second at Wolverhampton was full of promise, splitting next-time-out winners despite suffering an interrupted passage and with improvement on the way, he'll take some stopping. Kashooda may have to play second fiddle to another Gosden inmate.

  1. PYRAMID
  2. KASHOODA
  3. ROXY POWER (USA)

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
IZZARI and Ballybunion both shaped much better than the bare result last time with the former shading the vote. Gladiadora made it 2 from 2 here in good style recently so she's another to consider.

  1. IZZARI (GER)
  2. BALLYBUNION (IRE)
  3. GLADIADORA (IRE)

races.name: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
CARAGIO shaped best before his stamina ran dry in a well-run edition of the 'Leger Legends' at Doncaster just over a fortnight ago, so he's very much of interest back at 7f on his return to handicap company. Recent 3-y-o scorer Justice Court remains unexposed after just 4 career starts, while Packetofbiscuits, a dual C&D winner earlier in the year, is also one to bear in mind having returned to his best when edged out only by a course specialist at Yarmouth recently.

  1. CARAGIO (IRE)
  2. JUSTICE COURT (IRE)
  3. PACKETOFBISCUITS

races.name: Golf & Gallop Southwell Golf Club Handicap
races.verdict:
MASSIMO BLUE made a fine start for this yard when winning twice over C&D last month and he can regain the winning thread after a rare slow break put him on the back foot last time. The reliable Come On Over is also shortlisted alongside Mr Cool, who should benefit from the step back up to 6f.

  1. MASSIMO BLUE
  2. COME ON OVER (IRE)
  3. MR COOL (IRE)

races.name: John Lynch Memorial Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
TRUBSHAW is a 3-time Flat winner and looks to have been found a winnable opportunity on hurdles debut. Je Suis Celebre seemed set to place on hurdling debut before falling and rates the chief threat, with that form since boosted by Golden Handshake and Approval. Lightly-raced Blue Johnl improved last time and is also respected.

  1. TRUBSHAW
  2. JE SUIS CELEBRE
  3. BLUE JOHNL (IRE)

races.name: Allman Contracts Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
ROC DINO gave his all behind a useful rival when second at Galway in July and he can build on that effort for his leading yard. He is preferred ahead of Dad Sez, who isn't taken lightly on the back of his wide-margin maiden success at Kilbeggan, while Clay Pigeons helps give Willie Mullins a strong hand in the race.

  1. ROC DINO (FR)
  2. DAD SEZ (IRE)
  3. CLAY PIGEONS (IRE)

races.name: M.J. Carroll ARRO Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Plenty with chances but IFIWEREARICHMAN is taken to gain a deserved first success of the season having not enjoyed the rub of the green when a good eighth in a big-field Galway handicap last time. Willie Mullins' unexposed handicap debutant Livio heads the list of dangers with Matt Connor and Serienmond also well in the mix in this competitive handicap.

  1. IFIWEREARICHMAN (IRE)
  2. LIVIO (FR)
  3. MATT CONNOR (IRE)

races.name: Kathleen Walsh Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
LALIGURASH proved a different proposition when only narrowly denied at Killarney last time and, with better still to come upped further in trip, he could be ready to get off the mark. Tropical Image was successful at this meeting a year ago and heads the list of dangers, with Annie Button and Opposite Ends also in the mix.

  1. LALIGURASH (IRE)
  2. TROPICAL IMAGE (IRE)
  3. ANNIE BUTTON (IRE)

races.name: Charlie Chute Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
BLAZE THE WAY wasn't disgraced in valuable handicaps at the end of last season and, now just 1 lb above his last winning mark, is taken to resume winning ways returned to these calmer waters. A Penny A Hundred returned to form at Galway from a lenient mark and is feared most. West Away ran well from out of the weights when third at Killarney last month and is also one to consider.

  1. BLAZE THE WAY (IRE)
  2. A PENNY A HUNDRED (FR)
  3. WEST AWAY (IRE)

races.name: John & Terry Moriarty Memorial (Q.R.) Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
There should be more to come from JUSTATAN on the back of his Galway chase debut second and he's preferred to Eric McNamara pair Hees Dynamite and Illtakehimmyself.

  1. JUSTATAN (FR)
  2. HEES DYNAMITE (IRE)
  3. ILLTAKEHIMMYSELF (IRE)

races.name: Listowel Printing Works Slan Abhaile (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
GREEN STYLE marked himself down as a useful prospect when scoring in good style at Cork early last month and should prove hard to beat. Iron Sword can give the selection most to think about, ahead of Game Shadow.

  1. GREEN STYLE (IRE)
  2. IRON SWORD (FR)
  3. GAME SHADOW (IRE)

races.name: Le Charly's - Prix Du Paddock Handicap
Prix Duc D'albuquerque - Challenge De L'obstacle Equinaxy Handicap Chase
Prix Pierre Et Bernard Cypres Hurdle
Prix Claude Le Lorrain - Joseph Audon Listed Handicap Hurdle
Prix De La Place De L'alma - Attele
Prix De La Porte De Courcelles - Attele
